constraints.name: fk_pc_survey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, survey_id) REFERENCES surveys(company_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_surveys_appointment
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(company_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_surveys_customer
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id) REFERENCES customers(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: surveys_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: surveys_completed_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (completed_by) REFERENCES user_profiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_surveys_integrity
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_surveys_integrity BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON surveys FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_surveys_integrity()

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_surveys
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_surveys BEFORE UPDATE ON surveys FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_surveys
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_surveys BEFORE UPDATE ON surveys FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: idx_surveys_company_completed_at
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_surveys_company_completed_at ON public.surveys USING btree (company_id, completed_at)

indexes.name: surveys_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX surveys_pkey ON public.surveys USING btree (id)

indexes.name: unique_survey_appointment
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX unique_survey_appointment ON public.surveys USING btree (appointment_id)

indexes.name: uq_surveys_company_customer_id
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_surveys_company_customer_id ON public.surveys USING btree (company_id, customer_id, id)
